# mailchannels_dkim_key (Resource)

A MailChannels-managed DKIM key pair for a sending domain. MailChannels keeps the private key and signs messages with it; publish `dns_record_value` as a TXT record named `dns_record_name` with your DNS provider.

The Email API cannot delete a key or change its selector, algorithm or length: changing any of those replaces the key, and destroying the resource sets the key's status to `retired`. A key that is retired or revoked outside Terraform is treated as deleted and created again on the next apply, which fails with a conflict because the selector is still taken; choose a new selector in that case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailchannels_dkim_key" "example" {
  domain   = "example.com"
  selector = "mcdkim"
}

# Publish the key with any DNS provider, for example Cloudflare:
resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "dkim" {
  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name    = mailchannels_dkim_key.example.dns_record_name
  type    = mailchannels_dkim_key.example.dns_record_type
  content = mailchannels_dkim_key.example.dns_record_value
  ttl     = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Sending domain the key signs for, in lower case.
- `selector` (String) DKIM selector, 1 to 63 characters.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Key algorithm. Only `rsa` is supported.
- `key_length` (Number) Key length in bits: 1024, 2048, 3072 or 4096.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created (RFC 3339).
- `dns_record_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the DKIM TXT record, `<selector>._domainkey.<domain>`, without a trailing dot.
- `dns_record_type` (String) Type of the DKIM DNS record, `TXT`.
- `dns_record_value` (String) Value of the DKIM TXT record, `v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=...`.
- `dns_record_value_chunks` (List of String) `dns_record_value` split into strings of at most 255 characters, for DNS providers that need a long TXT value as several strings. For Route 53, use `records = [join("\"\"", mailchannels_dkim_key.example.dns_record_value_chunks)]`.
- `id` (String) `<domain>/<selector>`.
- `public_key` (String) Base64-encoded public key.
- `status` (String) Key status: `active`, `rotated`, `retired` or `revoked`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# DKIM keys are imported as <domain>/<selector>.
terraform import mailchannels_dkim_key.example example.com/mcdkim
```
